Those public domain ebooks were downloaded from https://onemorelibrary.com/

`gutenberg_csb_all_2025-10.zim` is a Project Gutenberg ZIM archive from Kiwix
(https://download.kiwix.org/zim/gutenberg/), used as a fixture for the ZIM
reader tests. It is the smallest Gutenberg archive that still contains a book
(the Kashubian library, a single title), kept small on purpose to avoid bloating
the repo.
